name: CAULOPHYLLUM THALICTROIDES
key_symptoms: Cardialgia, spasms of stomach. Dyspepsia with spasmodic symptoms.
Severe drawing, erratic pain and stiffness in small joints, fingers, toes, ankles, etc. Aching in wrists. Cutting pains on closing hands. Erratic pains, changing place every few minutes.

gi_symptoms: Cardialgia, spasms of stomach. Dyspepsia with spasmodic symptoms.
urinary_symptoms: Extraordinary rigidity of os (Bell; Gels; Ver v). Spasmodic and severe pains, which fly in all directions; shivering, without progress; false pains. Revives labor pains and furthers progress of labor. After pains. Leucorrhœa, with moth-spots on forehead. Habitual abortion from uterine debility (Helon; Puls; Sab). Needle-like pains in cervix. Dysmenorrhœa, with pains flying to other parts of body. Lochia protracted; great atony. Menses and leucorrhœa profuse.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Severe drawing, erratic pain and stiffness in small joints, fingers, toes, ankles, etc. Aching in wrists. Cutting pains on closing hands. Erratic pains, changing place every few minutes.
skin_symptoms: Discoloration of skin in women with menstrual and uterine disorder.
